research_question: How do benthic oxygen uptake rates and environmental drivers compare between shelf and deep-sea habitats across the Barents, central Arctic, Laptev, and Beaufort Seas?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are comparing benthic ecosystem functioning in Arctic shelf and deep-sea sediments. Our baseline draws on data from the Polarstern PS94 expedition for the Barents Sea and central Arctic, together with previously published data for the Beaufort Sea (2008/2009) and the Laptev Sea (Polarstern ARK-XXVII/3, 2012). Can you find the PANGAEA dataset DOIs for these, and the benthic flux parameters they report?

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have the DOIs for the datasets (10.1594/PANGAEA.863150, 10.1594/PANGAEA.892279, 10.1594/PANGAEA.892280, 10.1594/PANGAEA.892286, 10.1594/PANGAEA.907889, 10.1594/PANGAEA.908091), please retrieve the actual data tables for all six of them so we can begin merging and analyzing the habitat differences between shelf and deep-sea environments.
